transfer_metrics_provisional.ss_definition: smallest adjacent-sample swing below threshold and above 1e-16 A

lead_calibration.calibration: infinite nanowire FD dispersion integral at prescribed donor line density; no current fit

frozen_contact_current_only.model_difference: Same saved potential, masses, grid, retained transverse space and interior FD projection. Semi-infinite continuation replaces only terminal x hard walls and finite distributed baths. The second chemical potential comparison is separately calibrated, never a fitted current.
frozen_contact_current_only.limitation: Current quadrature on a frozen finite-bath SCF field does not establish semi-infinite density, charge neutrality or coupled SCF convergence; a quadrature estimator can miss exceptionally narrow peaks.

cross_sweep_consistency.note: Same model/config and biases, independent continuation histories. Agreement does not prove uniqueness of a nonlinear SCF fixed point.
